notes: Polygon is a ~1.5x1.3 km box around GreenLine, so 'inside' rows also include adjacent non-GreenLine stock: BC Oner (Анет баба 9в), Зеленый квартал / Green Mall (Сыганак 17*), Sultan Beibarys (Сыганак 22/1), BI City Seoul/Tokyo, Комсомольский (Нарикбаева 6), Самрук Тауэрс, Liberty, Eco Park, Evolution; the 'complex' field lets you filter to GreenLine.* if needed (blank complex = not printed on card). Small storage units (Склады, 1-12 m2, mostly parking/basement kladovki) are kept as listed; they pull ppm down for sale (200-1 100k/m2) - use stats.*.median_ppm_area_ge_15 for premises-only medians. Sale includes whole buildings (6 500 m2 Мухамедханова 19А at 12.5 bn; 1 500 m2 BC Oner; 922-1 000 m2 Сыганак 17ф). Basement flag comes from visible card text only (snippets truncated); 1016511851 flagged from '-1 этаж'; 1015760811 says '0 этаж' but left false. Several _txt_ hits that are clearly GreenLine (e.g. rent 1016534229 Sakura E-900 8, 1016538487 Tokyo, 1015719100 Aurora Айтеке би 3А, 1016017706/1016407263 Verda; sale 1016510047 Tokyo) were not in the polygon results (pin likely mis-geocoded or listing outside box) and were dropped per instruction; others dropped are BC Omega (Асфендиярова 8а/11), Култегин 14/17, W Towers (Туран 37), Асфендиярова 3. 1013561929 and 1016428786 look like the same 170 m2 4YOU unit (3.74 m/month) posted twice; both kept since ids differ. 1015820365 card says 136.5m, text mentions 140m. 1016369490/1016368283 area differs card vs text (270/260, 141/147); card values used. No duplicate ids across pages. All rows: price/area matches printed ppm within 3%.
